name: MUGEN
description: MUGEN is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate multi-audio understanding capabilities of large audio-language models across speech, general audio, and music. It measures model performance in multi-audio settings and identifies challenges such as input scaling and robustness to audio permutations.
reputation: A new benchmark for multi-audio understanding that is not yet widely established, but is relevant for evaluating large audio-language models across speech, audio, and music.
notes: Focuses on multi-audio input scaling challenges and proposes training-free strategies like Audio-Permutational Self-Consistency and Chain-of-Thought to improve robustness.
